about: Authoring source for eval/testset/items.json. Each item is an English gloss of a worker answer with gold labels; build_testset.py translates, back-translates, voices and noises it. gold covers exactly the steps of the item's question (referenceQuestions[].stepIds). wrong_language and silence items are gold unclear on every step, because the correct response is to abstain: a covered rating there is an unsafe error, and an unclear rating is exact. demo items take their text, gloss and gold from catalog demoScripts: the round's own answer, or (since 16 Oct) the round's followUps answer to the item's questionId; demo.round is the 0-based index into the script's rounds, here and in items.json (endpoint 24's round is demo.round + 1). fidelity review on a new item means its back-translation has not been read against the gloss yet. heldOut (v0.5) is true exactly for the items on the held-out tasks (eval config HELD_OUT_TASKS: confined-space and fragile-roof, which have no demo script and whose words no prompt example uses); their glosses were written fresh, with no phrasing from the prompts.

items.gloss: Before I go down, I'll test the air with the gas meter, and I'll keep it switched on the whole time I'm inside. The blower stays running. And I'll be in my harness, hooked to the winch rope on the tripod, before I climb in.
items.note: Held out (v0.5). All three: the gas test before entry, kept on inside (s1); the blower running (s2); the harness on the tripod winch rope (s3, the SOP-only step).

items.gloss: I'll test the air with the gas meter before I go in, and keep it on me, switched on, until I'm out. I'll wear the harness with the winch rope clipped to it.
items.note: Held out (v0.5). The gas test and the harness on the winch rope are stated; the blower is not (s2 missed).

items.gloss: I'll climb down first and switch on the gas meter when I reach the bottom. The harness catches on the ladder in a narrow hole, so I'll leave it up top.
items.note: Held out (v0.5). Tests the air only after entering (s1, wrong order) and leaves the harness behind (s3, the SOP-only step). The blower is not mentioned (s2 missed).

items.gloss: If my partner stops answering, I won't go down after them. I'll shout for help and wind them up with the winch from the top.
items.note: Held out (v0.5). The negation is the safe action: not going in to rescue, and raising the alarm, covers s4. Spot-checked, because the gold depends on the negation surviving translation.

items.gloss: If my partner goes quiet, I'll go straight down and carry them out myself. Waiting for help wastes time, and the gas was already checked this morning.
items.note: Held out (v0.5). Fluent and reasoned, and the way would-be rescuers die: going in after a collapsed worker (s4 contradicted).

items.gloss: I've been going down these holes for twenty years. I know my way around them.
items.note: Held out (v0.5). Experience claimed and nothing else: no gas test, blower or harness is named, so no step is addressed (all missed). Written without the judge prompt's own never-covered examples (OK, yes, understood, careful).
